name: dumbbell romanian deadlift to squat
description: A combo that links a Romanian deadlift with a squat in one fluid rep. It works the hamstrings, glutes and quads together.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the weights along your legs with a flat back.
Feel the hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Bend your knees and sit down into a squat with your chest up.
Stand back up and repeat the sequence.
